**Exercise 3: MNAR Detection**
```python
# Check if missingness correlates with target
# If yes → MNAR, add indicator!
missing_pattern = data['income'].isna()
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency
chi2, p_value = chi2_contingency(pd.crosstab(missing_pattern, y))
if p_value < 0.05:
    print("MNAR detected! Add missing indicator")
```

sections.title: Imbalanced Data Problems & Solutions
sections.body:
### Problems with Standard Algorithms

### **1. Biased Predictions**

```python
# Train standard logistic regression (NO balancing)
lr_baseline = LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000)
lr_baseline.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predictions
y_pred_baseline = lr_baseline.predict(X_test)
y_pred_proba_baseline = lr_baseline.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Evaluation
print("BASELINE MODEL (No Balancing):")
print("=" * 60)
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred_baseline, target_names=['Majority', 'Minority']))

# Confusion matrix
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred_baseline)
print(f"\nConfusion Matrix:")
print(f"  TN: {cm[0,0]:4d}  |  FP: {cm[0,1]:4d}")
print(f"  FN: {cm[1,0]:4d}  |  TP: {cm[1,1]:4d}")
print()
print(f"Accuracy: {(cm[0,0] + cm[1,1]) / cm.sum():.3f}")
print(f"Recall (Minority): {cm[1,1] / (cm[1,0] + cm[1,1]):.3f} ← TERRIBLE!")
print(f"Precision (Minority): {cm[1,1] / (cm[0,1] + cm[1,1]):.3f}")

# Visualize confusion matrix
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
im = ax.imshow(cm, cmap='Blues', alpha=0.7)

# Add text annotations
for i in range(2):
    for j in range(2):
        text = ax.text(j, i, f'{cm[i, j]:,}', ha='center', va='center',
                      fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', 
                      color='white' if cm[i, j] > cm.max()/2 else 'black')

ax.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
ax.set_xticklabels(['Predicted Majority', 'Predicted Minority'])
ax.set_yticklabels(['True Majority', 'True Minority'])
ax.set_title('Baseline Model: Misses Most Minority Samples!', fontweight='bold', fontsize=14)
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("\nPROBLEM:")
print("  - High accuracy (95%+)")
print("  - Low recall for minority class (often <50%)")
print("  - Model biased toward majority class")
```
